original_method: Map logical BMC I2C-15 to Linux bus14 and identify0x44 as first-PG548 UPHY3; confirm pointer0xc00000 is a safe readable register; capture bus owner and first-PG548/UPHY error baseline; avoid broad scan; issue one bounded combined read; decode four bytes against the installed UPHY revision; correlate bus/UPHY telemetry and confirm second-PG548 evidence was not substituted.
